usage: arb-engine quote [-h] [--sport {nfl,tennis,ncaaf,nba,nhl,mlb}] [--venues VENUES]
                        [--contracts CONTRACTS] [--target-margin TARGET_MARGIN] [--books]
                        [--candidate-margin CANDIDATE_MARGIN] [--gold]
                        [--max-quote-age MAX_QUOTE_AGE] [--markets MARKETS]
                        query

positional arguments:
  query

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sport {nfl,tennis,ncaaf,nba,nhl,mlb}
  --venues VENUES
  --contracts CONTRACTS
                        reference size for fee rounding
  --target-margin TARGET_MARGIN
                        required locked-in margin per $1 payout for max-buy prices
  --books               second pass: fetch real order books for candidate events (margin above
                        --candidate-margin) and re-size
  --candidate-margin CANDIDATE_MARGIN
                        events at or above this top-of-book margin get real depth in the --books
                        pass
  --gold                price Robinhood commission at the Gold rate
  --max-quote-age MAX_QUOTE_AGE
                        seconds; snapshots older than this are excluded from arb legs
  --markets MARKETS     comma list of market types to include
